image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a physical restaurant menu board or large printed menu. The background is white with red text and decorative elements. The header features the word 'DURLEY' in a stylized font inside an oval logo, flanked by red circular icons. The body contains lists of items with prices, organized into sections, though the text is largely illegible gibberish due to AI generation artifacts. A green plant is visible in the bottom left corner, and a person's arm/hand holding a phone is partially visible in the bottom right.
